name: OpenStreetMap Pedestrian Way Network
geographicCoverage: Bengaluru Pilot Study Area (South: 12.9200, West: 77.5700, North: 12.9850, East: 77.6200)
collectionPeriod: Continuous crowd-mapped spatial vector graph (Extract: October 2026)

attributeDefinitions.highway: Road and path classification (footway, pedestrian, residential, tertiary, secondary, primary)
attributeDefinitions.sidewalk: Dedicated pedestrian sidewalk presence (both, left, right, separate, none, unmapped)
attributeDefinitions.crossing: Pedestrian road crossing points (traffic_signals, marked, unmarked, uncontrolled)
attributeDefinitions.tactile_paving: Tactile ground indicators for visually impaired pedestrians
attributeDefinitions.wheelchair: Physical accessibility classification for mobility devices

limitations: Footpath survey completeness varies by neighborhood and municipal ward.
Unmapped sidewalk tags denote absence of survey data, NOT physical absence of walking space.
Curb-cut ramp slopes and surface smoothness are not comprehensively surveyed.

name: OpenStreetMap Way Lighting & Luminaire Assets
geographicCoverage: Bengaluru Pilot Study Area (Ward 143 / South End / Lalbagh / Jayanagar)

attributeDefinitions.lit: Street lighting tag on network ways (yes, no, 24/7, dusk-dawn, unmapped)

limitations: Only ~4% of street segments in the pilot area have explicit lit tags (1,618 lit, 54 unlit).
Missing lit tags represent unmapped survey gaps; uncertainty is preserved via neutral prior R_unknown=0.50.
A mapped lamp object does not guarantee electrical grid power or operational bulb functionality.
Vegetation canopy and building shadows may attenuate ground illuminance.

name: OpenStreetMap Civic Safety & Emergency Assistance POIs

attributeDefinitions.amenity=police: Police stations, police aid posts, and commissionerate outposts
attributeDefinitions.amenity=hospital: Hospitals, emergency trauma care centres, and public clinics

limitations: Operating hours, emergency desk staffing, and immediate dispatch readiness are unverified in OSM.
Physical proximity does not guarantee immediate emergency response.

name: NCRB Crime in India Official Statistics (Bengaluru Urban)
sourceOrganisation: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

attributeDefinitions.totalIpcCrimes: Total IPC registered offenses (24,198 cases, rate 286.6/100k)
attributeDefinitions.violentCrimes: Murder, attempt to murder, grievous assault (1,932 cases, rate 22.9/100k)
attributeDefinitions.crimesAgainstWomen: Assault on women, harassment, domestic cruelty (3,124 cases, rate 37.0/100k)

limitations: Aggregate district-level statistics cannot be distributed across individual streets without severe spatial misrepresentation.
Route-level incident coordinates are not openly published by Indian authorities.
Zero records in a loaded dataset does NOT imply zero crime on a walking route.

name: SafePath Moderated Community Environmental Observations
sourceOrganisation: SafePath Finder Community Contributors (Walkers of Bengaluru)

attributeDefinitions.dog_encounter: Street dog encounters (sighting, pack/group, aggressive, bite)
attributeDefinitions.lighting_concern: Broken luminaires, dark alleyways, malfunctioning feeder pillars
attributeDefinitions.hazard: Footpath construction obstructions, missing manhole covers, unsafe crossings

limitations: Crowdsourced reporting exhibits voluntary response bias and geographic clustering.
Zero reports on a street does NOT establish that the corridor is safe or hazard-free.
All personal identifying information is strictly stripped prior to public availability.

name: BBMP Municipal Luminaire Asset Inventory (Public Request)
sourceOrganisation: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) Electrical / Streetlighting Dept
licence: Proprietary / Public Downloadable Dataset NOT Published
collectionPeriod: PPP Streetlight Project (Shapoorji Pallonji / SMC Consortium)
limitations: INVESTIGATION OUTCOME: BBMP does not publish a publicly downloadable machine-readable luminaire database under an open license.
SafePath Finder strictly refuses to fabricate synthetic municipal luminaire records.
Status is honestly classified as UNAVAILABLE; lighting evidence relies solely on OpenStreetMap and verified community observations.
